_about: T1190 (re-review of #323): what the visible-text method keeps but cannot judge (kinds `possible-strike`, `image-clip-unknown`) on a PDF page that holds rows, accepted by the owner after he has looked at the page. Each item {pdf_page, kind, text, pdf_sha256, note} is matched on page + kind + text. Read by extract_synopsis (the run's one [unsure] line names any hit not here as NEW) and by the T426 gate (--check-against and `baseline check` fail on a NEW one). Pages without rows are not gated: their hits stay `[visible]` notes. Only the owner adds an item; an agent reports the hit instead.
